newsitem.title: USA: Music trade group says 1996 sales up 2 percent.
newsitem.headline: Music trade group says 1996 sales up 2 percent.

text.p: The Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) said Thursday that shipments of prerecorded music and music videos reached $12.5 billion in 1996, up about 2 percent over the 1995 total of $12.3 billion.
The association said unit shipments went up to 1.14 billion in 1996 from 1.11 billion units in 1995.

Hilary Rosen, the association's president, said the group has begun a joint record label, retail and wholesale initiative to examine what consumers think about today's music scene and is funding research to determine what it will take to foster America's passion for owning music.
